verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs describe a dedicated, native PostgreSQL database that you connect to directly, naming psql, Prisma, and Drizzle as clients, plus pooling, replicas, and PITR (appwrite-docs-46, appwrite-docs-8, appwrite-docs-23). This direct access applies to the dedicated native engine, not the default managed-API database (appwrite-docs-36). missing for 10: explicit documentation of the connection-string format and credentials, clarity on which plans or deployments (cloud vs self-hosted) offer direct connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration that standard ORMs work.
